# A taxed USD invoice: two CAD splits priced at one rate.
#
# 33.33 USD of consulting at 10% tax, posted at 1.4 CAD/USD. The tax is
# 3.333 USD, which the cent cannot hold, so it is 3.33; the income is 33.33.
# Each is then valued in CAD at the one rate and rounded on its own: 46.66 and
# 4.66. Their amount-over-value ratios are therefore close but not equal —
# 46.66/33.33 is 1.40006, 4.66/3.33 is 1.39940 — while the transaction used a
# single rate throughout.
#
# This is the ordinary shape of a taxed foreign invoice, and it is why no
# check is made on whether a transaction's base-currency splits "agree" about
# its rate: rounding produces the same difference as a genuine disagreement
# would, and the rounded figures cannot tell them apart. The cost is their
# aggregate — 51.32 CAD over 36.66 USD, which is 2566/1833 — and that is one
# number regardless of which split is read first.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_verify_costs.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

taxtable "Sales Tax"
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Tax:Sales Tax"
		rate: 10.0%
		type: PERCENT

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-TAXED"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 33.33
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "Sales Tax"
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-TAXED"
		accumulate: true
